items.headline: Guilt-free AI? What so-called “ethical AI” tools mean for musicians and producers
items.excerpt: Amidst a mounting backlash, music AI companies are talking of ethics, responsibility and transparency – but what does it actually mean, and how can producers know which tools to trust?

items.headline: AI ‘artists’ set to perform ‘live’ at first AI Music Awards in Los Angeles
items.excerpt: The first AI Music Awards lands at The Mayan in LA on 13 November, with AI ‘artists’ including Xania Monet performing live. The human creators behind each act will be “directing the stage”, according to organisers SIQA.

items.headline: Why AI Workflows Need Music Understanding and Search
items.excerpt: Conversational search and agentic music workflows only work when they are built on structured metadata that lets AI actually understand a catalogue. A look at what music understanding infrastructure means for creators and rights holders.

items.headline: ReSing Voices Vol 2 from IK Multimedia
items.excerpt: The latest expansion for IK Multimedia’s AI-powered vocal-modelling software has arrived, delivering a versatile set of new voice models aimed at modern music production tasks.

items.headline: Roland announces AI-assisted melody-generation plug-in, Melody Flip
items.excerpt: Roland's Melody Flip is designed to work as a "music creation partner" for generating melodic ideas, using AI to reshape and re-voice MIDI lines inside the DAW.

items.headline: DistroKid’s $2 billion valuation based on it being a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringement, says Universal
items.excerpt: Universal claims distributor DistroKid built its $2 billion valuation by acting as a pipeline for AI slop and copyright-infringing tracks. The suit puts distribution-side AI screening squarely on the agenda for every self-releasing artist.

items.headline: AI Is Reshaping the Music Industry, But Leaving Live Events Behind
items.excerpt: While AI investment transforms recorded music, its greatest untapped potential lies in helping live event professionals manage bookings, payments and workflows.

items.headline: Acon Digital’s machine learning-powered Acoustica 8 audio editor is the company’s “most ambitious release to date”
items.excerpt: The longstanding editing and restoration suite gets a major update loaded with AI-powered tools for cleanup, separation and spectral repair.

items.headline: Suno v6: The Next Generation of AI Music Arrives – Now With Warner Music and BMG’s Blessing
items.excerpt: Suno v6 brings three new AI music models plus a partnership with Warner Music and BMG. A hands-on look at what the new editing tools can actually do for producers.

items.headline: Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.excerpt: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, developed with industry partners including Warner Music, BMG and Believe – even as it keeps fighting other music companies in court.

items.headline: Suno Steals Artist Identities, Jason Isbell Wants to Stop It
items.excerpt: Jason Isbell and David Lowery’s new class action opens a new front in the AI music war: exploitation of an artist’s unique sonic identity rather than just their recordings.
